Override PDFPage custom draw /// - Tag: OverrideDraw override func draw(with box: PDFDisplayBox, to context: CGContext) { // Draw original content super.draw(with: box, to: context) // Draw rotated overlay string UIGraphicsPushContext(context) context.saveGState() let pageBounds = self.bounds(for: box) context.translateBy(x: 0.0, y: pageBounds.size.height) context.scaleBy(x: 1.0, y: -1.0) context.rotate(by: CGFloat.pi / 4.0) let string: NSString = "U s e r 3 1 4 1 5 9" let attributes: [NSAttributedString.Key: Any] = [ NSAttributedString.Key.foregroundColor: #colorLiteral(red: 0.4980392157, green: 0.4980392157, blue: 0.4980392157, alpha: 0.5), NSAttributedString.Key.font: UIFont.boldSystemFont(ofSize: 64) ] string.draw(at: CGPoint(x: 250, y: 40), withAttributes: attributes) context.restoreGState() UIGraphicsPopContext() } ```
